summary: Frontend-only test, done with Playwright at 400x860 on the preview URL plus a temporary Jest check over 3000 seeds (file deleted afterwards). BUG FIX verified: in 7 fresh runs plus 4 seeds x 5 acts (via localStorage jumps), the miniboss and boss were never the same team. act-intro-why and act-intro-bosses always name the same miniboss/boss as the crests (for example 'superare Zeus e poi battere Occult'). The seed check found 0 duplicates and why-text coherence in every case. Crests are shield badges in team colours (no pixel face, skull or checkered pattern). Map: leaders without a DS sprite (Occult, Rose Griffon, Brockenborg) render map-crest-<nodeId>; the others keep their sprite. CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: the Talenti tab crashed the whole app ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading nodes)'). After the fix: points 20; Colpo di Testa locked until Tiro di Base is at 1; m-bomber locked until tiro-base, testa and corsa are all at 3, then costs 3 PT (11 -> 8); the change survives a reload; talents-reset refunds everything (back to 20, talents {}). Sfide tab lists all 4 challenges. Talent effects: with Tiro di Base 1, run.talentFx.atkPct=2; Tattica del Nonno gives money 200 instead of 100. W10 boss won with boosted stats and no KO: run.challenges.perfect=1. Abandoning at W11 showed '+85 Spirito di squadra · +2 Punti Talento' with Checkpoint perfetto and Nessuna fuga ticked, and meta went 0->85 spirit, 0->2 PT. Fleeing at W11 set challenges.fled=true; abandoning showed '+37 · +1' with Nessuna fuga not awarded. Jest: 119 pass, 2 pre-existing unrelated failures.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. TalentNode got raw TALENT_PATHS[].nodes entries, which have no path/index fields. talentAvailable() then ran TALENT_PATHS.find(p => p.id === undefined).nodes and threw a TypeError, so opening meta-tab-talents blanked the app. Fix: pass TALENT_BY_ID[n.id].

The crest initials include the role prefix, because ActIntro passes name='Miniboss · Occult' and initials() runs on that string. Crests read 'MO', 'BRA', 'MZ', 'MEK', 'BE', 'BSA' instead of 'O', 'RA', 'Z', 'EK', 'E', 'SA'. Fix: pass the team name for the initials and a separate label for the caption.

/crests/ does not exist, and the SPA fallback answers /crests/.png with 200 text/html. Every crest with a teamId first renders an that is blank or broken, then switches to the placeholder after onError. A screenshot taken right after the intro opened showed empty crest slots. Fix: use a manifest of the crests that exist, or default to the placeholder.

issues: The Empire crest (#7dd3fc background, #f8fafc text) and the Zeus crest (#f8fafc background, #ca8a04 text) have low contrast, so the initials are hard to read.
When JourneyLog returns null (abandon at W1), an empty bordered Panel is still drawn.
Uncompleted challenges use text-slate-500 on a dark background, which is low contrast.

action_items: Keep (or rework) the TalentsPanel fix: pass the TALENT_BY_ID node, or make talentAvailable() not depend on node.path/index. Add a render test for TalentsPanel.
Compute crest initials from the team name, not from the 'Miniboss · X' / 'Boss · Y' caption.
Avoid the blank-image flash for crests that do not exist (crest manifest or placeholder by default).

Narrative: the act 1 consequence text is fixed to 'Jude Sharp lascia la Royal e sceglie la Raimon' and unlocks jude:base even when the W10 boss was Occult. This is the same kind of incoherence as the user's bug report.
Improve the contrast of the light-coloured crest palettes (the-empire, zeus).
critical_code_review_comments: talents.js talentAvailable depends on derived fields (path, index) that exist only in TALENT_BY_ID. Fragile: the unit tests pass but the UI crashed.
runTalentPoints counts floor(reached/10), not the bosses actually beaten. This is equivalent in normal play, but a save that jumps waves earns points without a boss win.
Nessuna fuga uses reached = wave-1 on a loss, so losing at the W10 boss does not earn it, although the text says 'Arriva almeno alla W10'. The wording or the threshold is ambiguous.
The talentFx 'money' key also flows into runPerkFx. It is harmless but unused there.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows pass after the Talenti crash fix; crest initials bug remains)

seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage was used, in disposable Playwright contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call gets a fresh localStorage, so do the whole flow in one script. Jump: run.wave=N, pending=null, overworld.completedWave=N-1, path=[], selectedNodeId=null, introSeen=act-1, then reload and click continue-run-btn. Boost: base/atk 3000, def 5000, spd 3000. Fight loop: click battle-acknowledge, pre-battle-keep or attack-button. Abandon: details-btn then abandon-btn (accept the confirm). Seeds 3277043427 and 3722705318 give the W10 Occult boss with map-crest-act1:boss:occult. Seed 1 act5 gives a Brockenborg miniboss crest.
